title: The Leeward Trail
author: Rosalind Brightwater
blurb: Zephyrine Reyes, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, has spent three years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the dry season ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
